name: Cleff
source:
A duck with an intense love of whole cream pies. Cleff is from "Toonmaica" and speaks with a noticeable accent. He hates when others misuse his pies.

[spoiler]In truth Cleff is violent and vindictive. He attempts to murder [url=/c143286]Clara[/url] due to her mishandling cargo and accidentally causing his mother's death. He either succeeds and is executed or fails and is killed by [url=/c143302]Coach Z[/url]. Coach Z remarks that Cleff was totally consumed by hatred and would have stopped at nothing to kill Clara. It's possible his memories and personality were altered by [url=/c145427]Flunky[/url] to make him more likely to kill.[/spoiler]
